```plato
//==
// # Random
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Random numbers and probability distributions
//  - Continuous distributions
//  - Gamma and beta family distributions
//  - Discrete distributions
//  - Multivariate distributions

//==
// # Random numbers and probability distributions
//
// A deterministic random-number generator state and a vocabulary of parametric
// probability distributions (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Random_number_generation;
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Probability_distribution). Distributions are
// pure parameter records; drawing samples pairs a distribution with a
// RandomState in a later pass. The distribution interface lives in
// `random.concepts.plato`, the distributions themselves in the sections below,
// and every body in `random.library.plato`.

// The state of a PCG-style pseudo-random generator
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Permuted_congruential_generator). State
// advances by a fixed linear-congruential step on every draw; Stream selects
// one of many independent sequences. The same (State, Stream) pair always
// yields the same next value, so generation is pure: each draw returns a new
// RandomState.
type RandomState
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    State: Integer;
    Stream: Integer;
}
```
